name: Lineage Piece
creator: Prlz's Den
redeem: Join the Prlz's Den group on Roblox and like Lineage Piece on its game page.
Launch Lineage Piece and make sure you have reached the level the code needs.
Click the Settings icon on the left side of the screen and scroll to the bottom.
Type the code into the box and press Enter to claim it.
notes:
Lineage Piece is an anime action RPG from Prlz's Den, released on Roblox in December 2025. You level up by beating bandits, bosses and dungeons across different islands, and collect weapons, melee styles and races based on anime characters like Naruto, Yuta and Elysia. The level cap is 7000, and endgame modes such as the Abyssal Sea ask you to clear timed rooms.

Codes give coins, gems and rerolls. Rerolls are the most valuable, since they let you try again for a better trait or race, and some races add over 25 percent damage. Every code has a minimum level, so higher-level players can claim more of them. New codes come with each update and like-goal, and the developers list them on the official Trello and in the Discord.

faq.q: Why does a Lineage Piece code not work for me?
faq.a: Every code has a level requirement, from level 100 up to level 1750. If your level is too low, the code will not redeem until you level up.

faq.q: Do I need to join the group to use Lineage Piece codes?
faq.a: Yes. Join the Prlz's Den group and like the game, then rejoin a server before trying the codes.

faq.q: Where is the code box in Lineage Piece?
faq.a: Open Settings from the icon on the left side of the screen and scroll to the bottom. Type the code there and press Enter.

tips: Beating bandits is the main way to level early on. Clear groups of them on each island, and only take on bosses once bandits stop being a challenge.
Try a few weapons and melee styles before settling on one. Many are based on anime characters, so pick the one whose moves you can land well.
Do not rush into the Abyssal Sea. Its rooms are timed, so slow kills can fail the run. Build your damage up first.
When the game shuts down, it usually means an update or bug fix. Rejoin afterwards to see what changed and check for new codes.
useRewards: Codes here unlock by level, so redeem them in waves. Claim the level 100 codes right away, then come back at levels 250, 750, 1000, 1500 and 1750 for the rest. Save rerolls for when you have time to roll a few in a row on your race or trait. Spend coins and gems on things that help you level faster, since higher levels unlock even more codes.
